top_signals.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits Baton Drop flaw to bypass Secure Boot
top_signals.summary: A new UEFI bootkit named BlackX, deployed in an espionage campaign in early 2026, exploited the old Baton Drop vulnerability to bypass Secure Boot and load a malicious driver designed to interfere with security solutions from Kaspersky and Avast. [...]

top_signals.title: Thermal Dynamics Launches New Cutmaster 90X and 110X
top_signals.summary: Thermal Dynamics, an ESAB brand, unveiled its next generation of manual plasma cutters, Cutmaster 90X and Cutmaster 110X, in booth #S29025 at FABTECH 2026 in Las Vegas. The Cutmaster X series features a consumables design and patented arc starting mechanism that has no moving parts.
